Hero_Desc_Amelia:
The secretary of the mayor of the elven city, Monatium.
A workaholic who runs Monatium for Elena.
Sometimes you can see her being a bit too obsessive with Elena... Those who have witnessed this all say that it was terrifying.
Album_Wish_Amelia: Being at Elena's side and assisting her.
Album_Amelia1: Amelia serves as the assistant and secretary to the elf mayor, Elena. Despite her typically stern demeanor, her admiration for Elena, whom she considers a mentor, is profound. Even while maintaining a tough exterior, her gaze softens when she is by Elena's side.
Album_Amelia2: Amelia aids Elena by addressing the flaws and imperfections in Elena's inventions. In fact, it seems Elena partly considers Amelia as a provider of after-sales services. Since Amelia thinks Elena can do no wrong, she appears genuinely content with this arrangement.
Album_Amelia3: Stepping in for the do-nothing mayor, Amelia single-handedly manages the elven city on her behalf. Her approach to city management... may feel a little authoritarian, but she insists it's all for achieving 'maximum efficiency.'
Album_Amelia4: As an engineer, Amelia displays capabilities nearly on par with Elena. But she believes her creativity falls short of Elena's, and without creativity, no matter how good you are, how can anything even be invented?
Album_Amelia5: Amelia has a colored past. She was once a copycat inventor, impersonating Elena. When Elena caught her, Amelia feared punishment, but Elena recognized her talent and took Amelia under her wing instead.
Album_Amelia6: Amelia went to great lengths to keep her private life, private. Maybe to avoid repeating the same mistake in the past, that led to her being caught by Elena?
Album_Amelia7: It wasn't until we became extremely close that Amelia finally invited me over. After passing through layers of security measures, I reached her tiny studio apartment. The moment I opened the door, I was stunned. Every inch of her walls was plastered with life-size cut-outs of Elena. There was even a life-sized statue...

LoveLetter_Amelia: Geez... Me, writing to a human? Never thought I'd see the day. I'll get straight to the point.Thank you, Master.I've spent a lot of time thinking, and I've realized I can't overlook the kindness you've shown me. Despite my rudeness, you've always looked out for me. I can't fully grasp it as an elf, but I recognize it must take incredible strength. This letter is a small token of gratitude from me.Just don't let the Mayor find out, okay?
LoveCall_Amelia:
Hello, Master. This is Amelia.
I was working when you suddenly came to mind, so I decided to call.
I was processing an official document and noticed it had come from the Order.
I suppose that naturally made me think of you.
Thank you for always treating us with the same unwavering kindness.
As an elf, I cannot fully understand the trust you place in us.
Even so, your feelings have left a deep impression on me.

Lately, I've found myself thinking this as well.
I feel as though I understand why everyone likes you so much, Master.
Being near you puts me at ease.
I also... Master... No, it's nothing. Please pretend you didn't hear that.
If you ever need my help, please don't hesitate to contact me.
It doesn't have to be official business. Personal matters are fine as well.
If it is something I can help with, I will. Thank you.
